findings.title: Propagate request cancellation to the store query.
findings.rationale:
context.Background() remains active after the client disconnects or the request context is canceled. The store can continue the query and retain database resources for abandoned reports. Pass r.Context() to h.Store.Query.

Proposed fix

-	rows, err := h.Store.Query(context.Background(), +	rows, err := h.Store.Query(r.Context(),

findings.title: Do not log the raw account query value.
findings.rationale:
account is untrusted input. %s preserves decoded line breaks and control characters, so a failed request can inject misleading log lines. The value may also expose an account identifier. Omit it, or log a validated and escaped identifier.

Proposed fix

-		log.Printf("monthly totals for %s: %v", account, err) +		log.Printf("monthly totals query failed: %v", err)
